definitions.full: H1991. hem [ הם ?, המה ?] only in מֵהֱמֵהֶם Ezek 7:11 Ew nothing of their moaning, wailing ; Thes RV wealth , compare הָמוֺן 5 , but precarious; form very suspicious; probably dittograph for preceding מֵהֶם ; strike out B Co.

occurrences.englishText: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
